paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Comparison of correlation between training loss (cross-entropy objective loss for Consistency-CE and Bi-objective loss for Consistency-Bi) and translation quality (BLEU score) on train subset of WMT15 De-En task for wait-k policy.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates a comparison of correlation values across different testing k values. The x-axis is labeled "testing k" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2 to 8, with tick labels displayed at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "Correlation" and uses a linear scale ranging approximately from 0.5 to 0.9. A blue, dashed line with circular markers represents "Consistency-CE", beginning at a value of 0.53 at x = 2, increasing to 0.73 at x = 8. A red, solid line with square markers represents "Consistency-Bi", starting at a value of 0.87 at x = 2, decreasing to 0.86 at x = 8.
